summary: Iter 73 — Icon refactor verification (WEB only, frontend only). All 4 requested authed pages render clean and show the new lucide glyphs. Verified via authenticated Playwright sessions across FOUR roles (admin=jenn, fresh Boat Owner, fresh Sailor, fresh Boat Pro) so every branch of Dashboard.jsx's role-gated tile set was exercised. (1) Dashboard (/dashboard): Boat Pro branch shows 'Manage your listing' (svg.lucide-pencil ×1) and 'Upgrade your plan' (svg.lucide-star ×1); Boat Owner branch shows 'Find a Boat Pro' (svg.lucide-handshake ×1) and 'Community feed' (svg.lucide-compass ×1); Sailor branch shows 'Crew Bank' (svg.lucide-users ×1) and 'Community Hub' (svg.lucide-compass ×1). All expected new icons rendered as real SVGs (non-zero bounding-box). Zero page errors, zero blank screens across all 3 role variants. (2) Crew Bank (/crew-bank): renders with 'Standalone Crew Bank' eyebrow using svg.lucide-users (was life-ring). svg.lucide-users ×1 present. Zero errors. (3) My Events (/my-events): renders as 'Organizer Dashboard'; svg.lucide-users ×2 (RSVPs + Crew signups stats — new for Crew signups). Zero errors. (4) Reviews (/reviews): renders 'Rate first. See second.'; svg.lucide-star ×1 on the 'You're done. Waiting on <name>.' hint (was Handshake); svg.lucide-handshake ×0 confirms the swap. Zero errors. (5) Additional: My Listing (/my-listing) rendered cleanly for the Boat Owner branch. Zero pageerrors captured on ANY of the tested pages; the only console warnings were a benign 401 on /api/photos and a 404 from /api/notifications/* for freshly-created accounts with no data — unrelated to this refactor. Icon component (frontend/src/components/Icon.jsx) imports Users/Sailboat/Handshake/Compass/ShieldCheck/Star/Pencil/etc. — every symbol used in the refactor exists in lucide-react (verified live in DOM as `svg.lucide-<name>`).
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx line 5 imports icons directly from 'lucide-react' rather than going through the unified /components/Icon.jsx wrapper. This is a mild deviation from the stated architectural direction in Icon.jsx ('New code should ALWAYS import from here and never from lucide-react directly (enforced by the ESLint guard).'). If the ESLint guard is actually enforced, Dashboard.jsx would trip it; if it isn't, consider migrating these pages to <Icon name='crew' /> etc. so tokens/tones flow through. Not a blocker for this refactor — the raw lucide imports render correctly — but worth a follow-up.

MyEvents.jsx and Reviews.jsx also import directly from lucide-react (Users/Star/Pencil). Same note as above; consider a follow-up pass to route them through the Icon wrapper for consistent tone/size tokens.

Dashboard.jsx line 76 shadows local variable 'Icon' with a destructured tile prop ('cards.map(({ icon: Icon }) => ...))'; because Dashboard.jsx does not import the wrapper Icon component this is harmless, but if the file is later migrated to use <Icon name='...' />, the alias will collide. Cheap rename to `IconCmp` would future-proof it.
